title: Authentication bypass by assumed-immutable data in Microsoft Identity Web allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network. (CVE-2026-80092)
description: CVE-2026-80092 is an authentication bypass vulnerability in Microsoft Identity Web caused by assumed-immutable data. This flaw allows an authorized attacker with limited privileges to elevate their privileges over a network. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.3. No specific affected versions or patch information are provided.
aiSummary: This vulnerability involves an authentication bypass in Microsoft Identity Web due to reliance on data assumed to be immutable. An attacker who is already authorized but with limited privileges can exploit this flaw to elevate their privileges within the network environment. The CVSS 3.1 vector indicates network attack vector, high attack complexity, low privileges required, no user interaction, unchanged scope, high confidentiality impact, and no integrity or availability impact. No patch or remediation details are available in the provided data.
aiImpact: An authorized attacker with limited privileges can bypass authentication controls to gain elevated privileges, potentially leading to unauthorized access to sensitive information. The confidentiality impact is high, but integrity and availability are not affected. This could allow attackers to access data or functionality beyond their intended permissions.
